context:
Goal: the auto-mode "Relayed Grant" entry in settings.json says the same thing as your ruling and the checker.
Problem (rule): settings.json line 56 still says a relayed grant never covers "a closed item (except an arbiter overturn)", and hooks/test_auto_mode_allow.py line 114 pins that clause. After your ruling own-748-b-rule-4, page_grant.py counts a routed closed item. So the entry and the checker disagree, and the classifier may refuse an act the checker counts (a false alarm, not a hole). The entry is yours to edit, so a lane cannot.
Based on (ruling): own-748-b-rule-4 (your 748 b). Based on (read): lane of PR #3224 (step answered-leaves-page) found the clash; the coordinator relayed it 13:47 CST.
Departs from: main, where the entry excludes a closed item — option a edits the entry and its pinned test to match your 748 b; option b leaves both as they are.
Meanwhile: PR #3224 is not blocked; the lane keeps working.

options.gain: The entry says what you ruled, so the classifier stops refusing a counted routed act.
options.label: Edit the entry and its pinned test to match your 748 b (lane's pick, recommended)
